welcomeSub: Use your work Google account, or the email and password your Admin gave you.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.sub: Type your work email and we’ll send you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.checkSub: If {email} is on the team, a link to choose a new password is on its way. It works for one hour.

newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.firstSub: Set your own password before you start. The one your Admin gave you stops working.
newPassword.nextSub: You’ll use it the next time you sign in.

recovery.title: Reset your password
recovery.sub: Continue to choose a new password for {app}.
